# Synthetic financial fixture

`synthetic-financial.pdf` is a deterministic one-page PDF made solely for tests.
It contains no real company data:

> Example Holdings — Synthetic FY2025 Report
> Revenue for FY2025 was USD 120 million.
> Operating cash flow for FY2025 was USD 25 million.
> Revenue for FY2024 was USD 100 million.

The opt-in smoke test asks for FY2025 revenue before and after a process restart.
This is a wiring check, not a financial accuracy benchmark or real investment data.
